title: INTRODUCTION TO MATERIALS SCIENCE
description: Crystal structure, microstructure, and physical properties of metals, ceramics, polymers, composites, and amorphous materials. Also includes elementary mechanical behavior and phase equilibria.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CH 202, 222Z, 222Z, 232 or 232H.
A minimum grade of C is required in CH 202, CH 222Z, CH 232 and CH 232H.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:50pm in LINC 128 - Learning Innovation Center 128 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
